ambiguity.detail: The book reveals the secret identity 'Juliana Ashcroft'.

verdict.hook_line: Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A captured maid watches helplessly as her cruel masters discard her family locket and discover her true identity.
verdict.why_it_works: The slow-burn discovery of the hidden name and the physical destruction of personal items creates a painful, addictive sense of dread.
